WHAT IS NOT VERIFIED (audit item B2 - do NOT present these as facts):
  * The upstream RELEASE/TAG these files came from is NOT RECORDED. There is
    no version macro in the vendored sources and no provenance file was kept
    at import. The copyright range 2009-2017 is the only date evidence.
  * Anyone diffing against upstream should compare the hashes below against a
    candidate MinHook release rather than trusting a version number.
